title: Intense tunneling under Clarkdale shook homes, residents compensated

tellings.quote: And one of the things we heard about from locals was that 20 years ago the drilling was so intense that things were shaking on the bookshelves and they were obviously tunneling underneath the village at Clarkdale where these people live.

plain: About twenty years ago, residents of the small town of Clarkdale, Arizona, are said to have felt drilling so intense beneath them that things shook on their bookshelves, as if someone were tunneling under the village, and the story holds that residents were compensated. The journalist Ross Coulthart repeats what local people told him while looking into what he believes is a hidden UFO base in the area. If true, it would point to a large secret underground project under the town.
